changes: In MATRIX, the LEV box always shows each track’s destination (MN, PHN, M+C, …), not only while CUE is held. Turning LEVEL still shows the level.
Uses less DSP time; the sound is unchanged. The module page now credits the author as Nathaniel Pavel (GitHub @npp1993).
Over USB, update the Modwerk base before the next sync. The newer base also fixes the LEV box showing split bars until CUE is pressed.
On the newest beta base, Output Matrix installs even when DSP room is short; its routing starts once there is room.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit as a card image, after a project or Part reload, or with MASTER TRACK and STUDIO.
First release: the CUE CFG box (shown as OUT CFG) gains MATRIX, which makes the headphone jack a third output beside MAIN and CUE.
CUE + LEVEL picks each track’s outputs (any mix of MAIN, CUE and PHONES, or one of six mono jacks), saved in the Part. MIX sets the PHONES level.
Switching to or from MATRIX converts every Part’s LEVEL and cue settings; switching to NORMAL also sets the project’s cue settings.
Takes the place of a stock reverb (SPRING REV first), which leaves the FX2 menu. Cannot be combined with Analog BD yet.
Over USB on the beta base: fixes MATRIX not being selectable and removal failing with an error. Switch the AUDIO page away from MATRIX before removing it.
